identification: Early Victorian / William IV flame mahogany linen press (gentleman's press), c1840-60, English or colonial. Two arched-panel doors with book-matched flame veneers, deep cavetto cornice, over two short and two long drawers with turned wooden knobs and brass escutcheons, plinth base. Interior: three fixed shelves (no linen slides) lined with old floral wallpaper. Small holes on the doors where knobs or escutcheons were lost; dull finish, some edge veneer wear. H201 W135 D56. Estimate $200-300, current bid $100 (27 Nov).
